description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in overseeing nursing operations and ensuring the highest standards of care.

This position offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 per year. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) and possess a strong commitment to quality and leadership in a skilled nursing setting. Join a team where your expertise is valued, and you can make a tangible difference in the lives of residents.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities

description:
We are seeking dedicated and compassionate Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) to join our team for full-time PM shifts at a premier skilled nursing facility in Vernon, AL. In this vital role, you will provide essential direct care to our residents, ensuring their comfort, safety, and well-being. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of those we serve.

As a CNA, your responsibilities will include assisting residents with activities of daily living (ADLs) such as bathing, dressing, grooming, and mobility. You will also monitor vital signs, document observations, and communicate effectively with the nursing staff to ensure comprehensive and personalized care plans are followed. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about healthcare and committed to fostering a supportive and respectful environment for our residents.

Join a team that values your dedication and provides a supportive work environment. If you are a certified CNA looking for a rewarding full-time position on the evening shift, we encourage you to apply and become a part of our compassionate care team.
requirements: Current Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification in Alabama
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care environment
Ability to work full-time PM shifts
Commitment to providing compassionate patient care
